title: Trucker Hourly Rate T-Shirt
custom_label_1: Comfort Colors Premium Heavyweight Garment-Dyed Tee
description:
The trucker hourly rate chart — prices go up the more you watch, help, or try to do it yourself.

Printed on a Comfort Colors 1717 heavyweight tee — 100% ring-spun cotton, garment-dyed for a soft, vintage feel and a relaxed fit that gets better with every wash.

Sizing:

This shirt runs relaxed and oversized. Order your usual size for a relaxed look, or size down for a more fitted feel.
